profile.headline: Software engineer building AI/ML, vision, and secure systems.
profile.shortBio: University of Washington CSSE graduate focused on full-stack engineering, AI/ML tooling, computer vision, and secure software systems.
profile.longBio: I build practical software systems at the intersection of full-stack engineering, AI/ML, computer vision, and security. My work includes research software for microscopy analysis, adversarial machine learning pipelines, teaching support for core CS courses, and production-style projects using Next.js, Flask, Django, Firebase, and cloud deployment tooling.

research.title: CytoCV
research.homeSummary: Web-based platform for reproducible yeast microscopy image analysis.
research.detailSummary: Built a Django and JavaScript platform for the University of Utah Miller Lab with REST APIs, deterministic batch ML processing, PostgreSQL data storage, and Linux VM deployment for 15+ scientists.
research.impact: Reduced manual analysis by 97%, cut processing time by 73%, and reduced file storage by 56.6%.
bullets: Architected Python Django REST APIs and a JavaScript Fetch API frontend
Built TensorFlow/Keras Mask R-CNN segmentation workflows with OpenCV scikit-image and NumPy
Extracted 30+ cell-level metrics from microscopy data
Migrated SQLite to PostgreSQL and optimized storage by converting TIFF caches to PNG
Led a 6-person Agile team and maintained CI/CD deployment on a UW-IT Linux VM

research.title: Adversarial machine learning pipelines
research.homeSummary: Implemented adversarial attack and defense pipelines for image classification models.
research.detailSummary: Used Python, TensorFlow/Keras, NumPy, and Matplotlib to automate attack and defense testing while tracking success rates, latency, and accuracy.
research.impact: Optimized batched Keras defense execution to under 5 seconds while preserving 94% clean-data accuracy.
bullets: Implemented attack and defense workflows for image classification models
Automated experiment reporting for success rates latency and accuracy
Improved defense execution with batched Keras evaluation
